NE.facing_validation: isometric UP-RIGHT / AWAY; visually verified rear view (back of head, back, root spine, rear legs)

SE.facing_validation: isometric DOWN-RIGHT / TOWARD; visually verified front view (eyes, chest, torso, forward hands)

NW.facing_validation: lossless horizontal mirror of NE around the x=128 shared contact pivot; rear view retained

SW.facing_validation: lossless horizontal mirror of SE around the x=128 shared contact pivot; front view retained

migration_reason: The inspected late_enemy_visuals.gd clamps delivered direction sheets to 24 frames and is restricted to prismback/harrier/broodmother with 384px nominal cells. It cannot correctly consume this standard troll family (48 frames, 256px cells) without an explicit standard-enemy directional adapter.
exact_migration_notes: Keep late_enemy_visuals.gd unchanged: troll is a standard enemy and its existing 24-frame late-enemy clamp is incompatible with this 48-frame family.
In enemy_animation.gd, retain the existing CELL=Vector2(256,256), ANCHOR=Vector2(128,224), COLUMNS=8, FRAME_COUNT=48, FPS=24.0 and DURATION=2.0 contracts.

Add a troll-only directional sheet dictionary with explicit static preloads: res://assets/template/InvadersIlluminated/troll/NE.webp, SE.webp, NW.webp and SW.webp. Other standard enemy paths remain unchanged.
Add a standard facing_for_displacement mapping matching the verified isometric contract: displacement.x>0=>SE, displacement.y>0=>SW, displacement.x<0=>NW, else=>NE.

Extend the standard frame selector to accept a facing only for troll and select the directional troll sheet before making the existing 256px AtlasTexture region. Keep its phase, FPS and 48-frame indexing unchanged.

In world.gd _draw_enemy, pass enemy_segment_displacement(e) through that mapping for troll and set flip=false for troll. Do not also mirror at draw time, because NW/SW are already authored lossless cell mirrors around contact x=128.
Point any troll static/portrait consumer that is migrated with this family to res://assets/template/InvadersIlluminated/troll/icon.webp; do not use it to replace gameplay logic or ability tells.
Register the five files and their imports in the parent integration step. No simulation, movement, HP, rewards, ability tell, or behavior code changes are required.
